entries.name: hover lift
entries.semantic_description: Hover lift raising the element 4px with a softening shadow — tactile confirmation of clickability. The most universal hover effect.
entries.css: .hover-lift { transition:transform .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease; } .hover-lift:hover { transform:translateY(-4px); box-shadow:0 12px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); }

entries.name: hover scale-up
entries.semantic_description: Hover scale-up growing the element 5% — confident micro-interaction for buttons and image cards.
entries.css: .hover-scale-up { transition:transform .2s ease; } .hover-scale-up:hover { transform:scale(1.05); }

entries.name: hover scale-down
entries.semantic_description: Hover scale-down shrinking the element 3% — tactile press-down feel for clickable cards.
entries.css: .hover-scale-down { transition:transform .15s ease; } .hover-scale-down:hover { transform:scale(0.97); }

entries.name: hover glow
entries.semantic_description: Hover glow adding a luminous outer shadow in an accent color — cyberpunk hover for buttons and cards in dark-mode UIs.
entries.css: .hover-glow { transition:box-shadow .3s ease; } .hover-glow:hover { box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(139,92,246,0.6); }

entries.name: hover underline-grow
entries.semantic_description: Hover underline that grows from left to right — refined link hover with smooth width transition.
entries.css: .hover-underline-grow { position:relative; } .hover-underline-grow::after { content:''; position:absolute; left:0; bottom:-2px; width:0; height:2px; background:currentColor; transition:width .3s ease; } .hover-underline-grow:hover::after { width:100%; }

entries.name: hover image-zoom
entries.semantic_description: Hover image-zoom scaling the inner image while the container stays fixed — classic product-card hover pattern.
entries.css: .hover-image-zoom img { transition:transform .4s ease; } .hover-image-zoom:hover img { transform:scale(1.1); }

entries.name: hover tilt-3d
entries.semantic_description: Hover 3D tilt rotating the element on the X/Y axes based on cursor position — dynamic, playful interaction for product cards.
entries.css: .hover-tilt-3d { transition:transform .1s ease; transform-style:preserve-3d; }

entries.name: hover color-shift
entries.semantic_description: Hover color-shift smoothly transitioning background or text color — subtle, refined state change.
entries.css: .hover-color-shift { transition:color .3s ease, background-color .3s ease; } .hover-color-shift:hover { color:#8b5cf6; }

entries.name: hover border-draw
entries.semantic_description: Hover border-draw animating a border appearing to draw around the element — sophisticated outline-reveal pattern.
entries.css: .hover-border-draw { position:relative; } .hover-border-draw::before { content:''; position:absolute; inset:0; border:2px solid currentColor; border-radius:inherit; clip-path:polygon(0 0, 0 0, 0 100%, 0 100%); transition:clip-path .4s ease; } .hover-border-draw:hover::before { clip-path:polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); }

entries.name: hover text-slide-up
entries.semantic_description: Hover text-slide-up revealing hidden text from below — pattern for icon buttons that reveal labels on hover.
entries.css: .hover-text-slide-up .label { transform:translateY(100%); opacity:0; transition:all .3s ease; } .hover-text-slide-up:hover .label { transform:translateY(0); opacity:1; }

entries.name: hover rotate
entries.semantic_description: Hover rotate spinning the element 90 degrees — for refresh icons and toggle affordances.
entries.css: .hover-rotate { transition:transform .3s ease; } .hover-rotate:hover { transform:rotate(90deg); }

entries.name: hover shake
entries.semantic_description: Hover shake rapidly oscillating the element horizontally — playful error-state or attention pattern.
entries.css: .hover-shake:hover { animation:shake .3s ease; } @keyframes shake { 0%,100%{transform:translateX(0);} 25%{transform:translateX(-4px);} 75%{transform:translateX(4px);} }

entries.name: hover shine-sweep
entries.semantic_description: Hover shine-sweep animating a diagonal light streak across the element — premium CTA button hover.
entries.css: .hover-shine-sweep { position:relative; overflow:hidden; } .hover-shine-sweep::before { content:''; position:absolute; top:0; left:-100%; width:50%; height:100%; background:linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,0.4), transparent); transition:left .6s ease; } .hover-shine-sweep:hover::before { left:150%; }

entries.name: hover dim
entries.semantic_description: Hover dim reducing opacity to 70% — subtle de-emphasis pattern for grid items on sibling-hover.
entries.css: .hover-dim { transition:opacity .3s ease; } .hover-dim:hover { opacity:0.7; }

entries.name: focus ring-2

entries.name: focus ring-offset

entries.name: focus ring-glow

entries.name: js toggle-class
entries.semantic_description: Vanilla JS to toggle a class on click — universal pattern for interactive state changes. Used by accordion, dropdown, and modal triggers.

entries.name: js accordion-expand
entries.semantic_description: Vanilla JS accordion expand/collapse — toggles 'is-open' class on the parent panel and manages aria-expanded for accessibility.
entries.js: document.querySelectorAll('[data-accordion-trigger]').forEach(btn => { btn.addEventListener('click', () => { const expanded = btn.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true'; btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(!expanded)); btn.closest('[data-accordion]').classList.toggle('is-open', !expanded); }); });

entries.name: js modal-open
entries.semantic_description: Vanilla JS modal open — sets aria-hidden=false on the modal, traps focus inside, and adds a class to show. Returns focus on close.
entries.js: function openModal(id) { const m = document.getElementById(id); m.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false'); m.classList.add('is-open'); document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'; m.querySelector('[data-close]').focus(); }

entries.name: js modal-close
entries.semantic_description: Vanilla JS modal close — hides the modal, restores body scroll, and returns focus to the trigger element.
entries.js: function closeModal(id, returnFocusTo) { const m = document.getElementById(id); m.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true'); m.classList.remove('is-open'); document.body.style.overflow = ''; if (returnFocusTo) returnFocusTo.focus(); }

entries.name: js theme-switch

entries.js: function toggleTheme() { const isDark = document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark'); localStorage.setItem('theme', isDark ? 'dark' : 'light'); } document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark', localStorage.getItem('theme') === 'dark');

entries.name: js intersection-reveal
entries.semantic_description: Vanilla JS IntersectionObserver revealing elements as they enter the viewport — powers scroll-reveal animations without libraries.
entries.js: const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => { entries.forEach(e => { if (e.isIntersecting) { e.target.classList.add('is-visible'); io.unobserve(e.target); } }); }, { threshold:0.15 }); document.querySelectorAll('[data-reveal]').forEach(el => io.observe(el));

entries.js: function positionTooltip(trigger, tip) { const r = trigger.getBoundingClientRect(); tip.style.left = (r.left + r.width/2 - tip.offsetWidth/2) + 'px'; tip.style.top = (r.top - tip.offsetHeight - 8) + 'px'; }

entries.name: js dropdown-menu
entries.semantic_description: Vanilla JS dropdown menu — toggles 'is-open' on click, closes on outside-click and Escape key, manages aria-expanded.
entries.js: document.querySelectorAll('[data-dropdown]').forEach(dd => { const btn = dd.querySelector('[data-dropdown-trigger]'); btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); const isOpen = dd.classList.toggle('is-open'); btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(isOpen)); }); }); document.addEventListener('click', () => document.querySelectorAll('[data-dropdown].is-open').forEach(d => d.classList.remove('is-open'))); document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') document.querySelectorAll('[data-dropdown].is-open').forEach(d => d.classList.remove('is-open')); });

entries.semantic_description: Vanilla JS tab switch — handles tablist clicks, manages aria-selected, and toggles panel visibility. Full keyboard arrow-key navigation.
entries.js: document.querySelectorAll('[data-tabs]').forEach(tabs => { const triggers = tabs.querySelectorAll('[role=tab]'); triggers.forEach(t => t.addEventListener('click', () => { triggers.forEach(x => { x.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false'); document.getElementById(x.getAttribute('aria-controls')).hidden = true; }); t.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true'); document.getElementById(t.getAttribute('aria-controls')).hidden = false; })); });

entries.name: js carousel-next
entries.semantic_description: Vanilla JS carousel next/prev — updates the active slide index, translates the track, and updates dot indicators.
entries.js: function carouselGo(track, dir) { const slides = track.children.length; let idx = parseInt(track.dataset.idx || '0', 10); idx = (idx + dir + slides) % slides; track.dataset.idx = String(idx); track.style.transform = 'translateX(-' + (idx * 100) + '%)'; }

entries.name: js lazy-load-img

entries.js: const imgIo = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => { entries.forEach(e => { if (e.isIntersecting) { const img = e.target; img.src = img.dataset.src; img.removeAttribute('data-src'); imgIo.unobserve(img); } }); }); document.querySelectorAll('img[data-src]').forEach(img => imgIo.observe(img));
